arguments.command:
python -c "
import humanize

print('Testing metric:')
result = humanize.metric(1234)
print(f'  metric(1234) = {result!r}')
assert result == '1.2 k', f'Expected \"1.2 k\", got {result!r}'

result = humanize.metric(0)
print(f'  metric(0) = {result!r}')

result = humanize.metric(None)
print(f'  metric(None) = {result!r}')

result = humanize.metric(1234567)
print(f'  metric(1234567) = {result!r}')
assert result == '1.2 M', f'Expected \"1.2 M\", got {result!r}'

result = humanize.metric(0.001)
print(f'  metric(0.001) = {result!r}')
assert result == '1.0 m', f'Expected \"1.0 m\", got {result!r}'

result = humanize.metric(1234, 0)
print(f'  metric(1234, 0) = {result!r}')
assert result == '1 k', f'Expected \"1 k\", got {result!r}'

# Test more cases
result = humanize.metric(0.0001)
print(f'  metric(0.0001) = {result!r}')

result = humanize.metric(1234567890)
print(f'  metric(1234567890) = {result!r}')
assert result == '1.2 G', f'Expected \"1.2 G\", got {result!r}'

print('All metric tests passed!')
"
